builds.name: Leveling — Arms two-hander (Mortal Strike at 40, Enrage last)
builds.summary: Two-handed Arms leveling revised from the fight lab on 2026-09-26: Improved Rend, Deflection, Improved Charge and Improved Overpower first, Deep Wounds at 20, Impale and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, Bloodthrill, Weaponmaster and Mortal Strike at 40 (the one talent worth 40% of time per kill), then Fury for Cruelty, Unbridled Wrath, Blood Craze and Enrage. Charge, Bloodrage, Battle Shout, Victory Rush, Mortal Strike, Overpower after dodges, Rend, Execute under 20%, Heroic Strike with spare rage; bandage and eat between fights.

core.why: Worth +40% time per kill at 60 in the sim (the rotation has nothing else to spend rage on); reaching 30 Arms points by 40 is the whole point of the order.
+5% crit: +9-11% per kill in the sim through Deep Wounds, Overpower and Enrage procs.
Overpower on a Rended mob without waiting for a dodge: +9-10% in the sim.
Crit bleeds: +7-9% in the sim.
+10% damage after being hit, which happens constantly solo: +7-10% in the sim.
Overpower crits: +5-6%.
+3% crit with an axe or polearm: +5%.
+2 rage per white hit with a two-hander: +4%.
+5% parry: +3% per kill and fewer deaths; also the cheapest way to 30 Arms points.

Open search result (fury-dw-raid, full raid): 17/32/2 (Fury) at 929.2 DPS; opt-fury-dw-raid-raid-dps 885.5, fury-dw-raid 883.7 in the same fights; 9,040 builds simulated, 3 independent runs reached the top.
The spec's other builds on the pages (their best entry, full raid): opt-arms-2h-raid-raid-dps 898.1, arms-2h-raid 886.5.
Sibling rotations tried on it (10,000 fights): arms-2h-raid -2.8%, arms-battle-raid -15.1%; none adopted.
Talents the simulator measures at 0 DPS in this build (tier fillers; the filler audit may move them): Improved Rend, Improved Tactical Mastery, Booming Voice.
Simulator numbers are the community's model of the beta (ElliotWood/Forever 2ce8265 with this project's patches), not in-game measurements.

2026-10-11 filler audit (raidsim/filler_audit.py, user question on zero-value fillers): points the simulator measures at 0 moved, one at a time, to talents that help in a real raid (interrupt protection, threat, mana, range, survival; the simulator cannot see these, so the order is our judgment) or that gain DPS: Booming Voice -> Deflection (survival); Booming Voice -> Blood Craze (survival); Booming Voice -> Blood Craze (survival); Booming Voice -> Blood Craze (survival). Net +0.00% on a third seed.

2026-10-15: the 70291 machine-learning search (ElliotWood/Forever 2ce8265 with this project's patches, ml_pipeline.py --fresh) confirms this build for Fury: its full-raid winner is -0.34% against it, under the 0.5% bar for a new build.
